subject: Pilot: prefetch credits & quantization safeguard
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Alex Li <alex@dataforge.ai>
Cc: Maya Sengupta <maya@dataforge.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 May 2025 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot: prefetch credits & quantization safeguard

Alex / Maya —

Great to meet earlier. Based on the call, I pulled together a straightforward pilot construct aimed at two things: 1) give DataForge predictable unit economics for the initial production traffic pattern, and 2) protect inference quality while applying quantization and prefetch heuristics.

High-level proposal (attached: DF-pilot-MAP-2025.pdf):
- 6-week pilot, capped at 200M tokens processed.
- 10k free prefetch credits (applies to prefix/cache warmups) to offset initial KV-cache cold starts.
- Quantization guard: we propose 4-bit int8 fallback plan — Redwood will run quantized models with an automatic quality gate. If quality regressions exceed the threshold on your eval set, we fall back to FP16 for the affected batch and log the event; you get 1:1 credit refund for affected tokens.
- Pricing: pilot-only effective rate $0.0045 / 1k tokens after credits. If you convert to a committed plan within 30 days, credits roll into the first invoice.

Questions for you:
1) Does the pilot token cap map to your internal spike expectations (200M)?
2) Can you share the representative eval prompts (we discussed 200 examples) so we can tune the quantization guard?
3) Any procurement or SOC2 evidence folks I should loop in?

I'll attach a one-page mutual action plan and a short quant-recs spreadsheet — those should make the tradeoffs explicit. If this looks broadly OK, I can route a limited discount approval for the prefetch credits and coordinate legal for an SOW.

Thanks,
Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Sales Manager
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: DF-pilot-MAP-2025.pdf, quant-recs-DF.xlsx
From: Alex Li <alex@dataforge.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Maya Sengupta <maya@dataforge.ai>
Date: Fri, 2 May 2025 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot: prefetch credits & quantization safeguard

Ben —

Thanks for the deck and quick write-up. This is close to what we discussed. A couple of notes from our side:

- Token cap: 200M is OK for the first run, but we may need a soft overage buffer for peak days (approx +10%). Can that be handled as burst at the pilot rate?
- Prefetch credits: helpful. Procurement will want a clearer definition of what counts as a prefetch credit versus normal inference tokens (we saw notes in the doc but will need that in the SOW).
- Quantization guard: excellent idea. We'll definitely need the ability to run our 200 eval prompts against your quantized model prior to the pilot start. If the guard triggers, we need clearer SLAs on detection time and refund timeline.

Procurement loop: forwarding to our procurement lead (maya@dataforge.ai) — Maya, are there docs you need from Redwood to move the SOW and a one-off credit?

—Alex
Alex Li | Head of AI Product
DataForge, Inc.
alex@dataforge.ai | +1 (212) 555-0189
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Maya Sengupta <maya@dataforge.ai>, Alex Li <alex@dataforge.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 3 May 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot: prefetch credits & quantization safeguard

Maya / Alex —

Thanks — quick answers inline and attached a tightened SOW fragment for procurement:

- Burst overage: yes — we can allow a soft overage of up to 10% during the pilot at the same pilot effective rate. Any sustained overage beyond that will be discussed before billing.
- Prefetch credit definition: added a compact definition in section 2 of the SOW fragment — credits apply to server-initiated prefix/KV warmups (pre-tokenization and automatic prefetch) and do NOT apply to user-initiated prompts. I'll highlight examples so procurement can map this to your telemetry.
- Quantization guard SLAs: detection in pipeline within 2 hours of the offending batch being processed; refunds issued as account credits within 7 business days after confirmed regression. We'll log every event and provide the failing prompt batch for repro.

I've CC'd Karthik (inference leads) and Neha (commercial approvals) to confirm we can extend a one-time prefetch credit bundle of 10k and the 10% burst allowance. Karthik / Neha, could you confirm by EOD Monday if this is within standard pilot concessions?

Attached: DF-pilot-MAP-2025.pdf (updated), quant-recs-DF.xlsx (sample evaluation matrix).

Best,
Ben
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 4 May 2025 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot: prefetch credits & quantization safeguard

Ben / Neha —

Fine with the ask. A couple of operational clarifications from infra side: we will
- Tag the pilot project so prefetch credit consumption is separately reported.
- Implement the automatic quality gate with a conservative threshold (we used similar thresholds for two recent pilots and they performed as expected).

Neha: commercial OK to offer the 10k prefetch credits and 10% soft burst for a single pilot under deal DF-2534. Please issue a concessions note in HubSpot (link: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/12345/DF-2534) and I'll hand the infra runbook to support.

Neha Kapoor | Head of Commercial Operations
Neha.Kapoor@redwood.com
